We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at accenture.com
Accenture Products & Platforms for HR, Talent and Skilling (APP HTS) is a dedicated software business within Accenture, specializing in complementary applications for SAP environments. With a focus on enhancing SAP ERP Human Capital Management, SAP SuccessFactors, and SAP Plant Maintenance, APP HTS develops, sells, supports, and maintains innovative add-on solutions that extend core SAP capabilities. While our 150 specialists in software development, product management, support and testing help HR and Plant Maintenance teams to make the transition to working more efficiently and effectively, raising productivity, and driving better business outcomes.
For nearly two decades, APP HTS has been driving digital transformation and operational excellence across global enterprises. Today, more than 1,900 customers in over 48 countries rely on APP HTS to improve how SAP users work and live—empowering HR, talent, and skilling functions with intelligent, scalable tools.
To learn more about the Accenture Products & Platforms for HR, Talent and Skilling practice, please visit our site.
The Work:
As an SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Delivery Consultant, you will work closely with clients and cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize SAP EAM solutions and Accenture's BlueWorx asset management solutions that drive business value. You will play a key role in solution delivery, client engagement, and business development activities by demonstrating SAP EAM and BlueWorx capabilities, facilitating workshops, and building trusted client relationships. Join Accenture in helping organizations transform their asset management operations through industry-leading technology, innovation, and expertise.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and support the delivery of SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions across asset-intensive industries.
Implement and configure Accenture's BlueWorx asset management solutions, ensuring alignment with client business processes and SAP EAM environments.
Facilitate client workshops to gather business requirements, define solution designs, and align stakeholders on implementation approaches.
Configure and support SAP EAM processes including maintenance management, work management, asset management, preventive maintenance, and related integrations.
Conduct product demonstrations, solution showcases, and proof-of-concept activities for SAP EAM and BlueWorx solutions for clients and prospects.
Translate complex business requirements into practical SAP EAM and BlueWorx solution recommendations.
Collaborate with functional, technical, and business teams to ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction.
Support business development efforts by contributing to proposals, client presentations, demos, and solution discussions.
Build and maintain strong client relationships by providing trusted advisory services and delivering high-quality outcomes.
Identify opportunities to expand client value through the adoption of BlueWorx capabilities and complementary Accenture asset management offerings.
Stay current with SAP Asset Management innovations, BlueWorx solution capabilities, and industry best practices to provide thought leadership and strategic guidance.
#LI-EU
HERE'S WHAT YOU WILL NEED
Advanced proficiency in SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM).
Advanced proficiency in Client Relationship Management.
Experience delivering SAP EAM implementations, enhancements, or transformation projects.
Experience facilitating workshops, conducting solution demonstrations, and presenting to business stakeholders.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and consultative problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and manage competing priorities.
BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE
Experience with BlueWorx or other SAP EAM enhancement and optimization solutions.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA Asset Management.
Knowledge of maintenance planning, reliability, asset performance management, and field operations processes.
Experience conducting executive-level demonstrations and value-based solution presentations.
Intermediate proficiency in stakeholder engagement and organizational change management.
Experience supporting pre-sales activities, proposals, and client pursuits.
Knowledge of asset-intensive industries such as Utilities, Chemicals, Mining, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, or Transportation.
Experience integrating SAP EAM with Supply Chain, Inventory Management, Finance, GIS, or mobile maintenance solutions.
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
